narrative_markdown:
## Today's Forecast

Mostly cloudy skies open the forecast with a high of 29°C / 84°F and a low of 20°C / 67°F, featuring afternoon showers and thunderstorms bringing 14.5 mm (0.57 in) of rain at a 100% chance between 13:00 and 17:00. Thunder possible from the morning, peaking this evening. Skies remain mostly cloudy through midday and turn overcast in the evening. Wind is northeasterly overnight, turning southwest by midday, with gusts up to 39 km/h (21 kt). The peak UV index reaches 8.9 today. Air quality ground stations report an AQI of 55 at Kisumu Airport, 32 at Kisumu Central, and 33 at Dunga Beach. As of 06:01, reports through 03:30: no rain; no thunder; high so far 22°C / 72°F; low so far 21°C / 70°F; peak sustained 4 km/h; sky mostly clear.

## Extended Outlook

Temperatures and winds much the same through Tuesday, with showers and thunderstorms likely each day. Skies mostly cloudy Sunday, then partly cloudy Monday and mostly cloudy Tuesday. Rain loses support through Tuesday, from all four models Sunday to two of four models Tuesday. Tuesday's call: rain, 75%, with two of four models wet; highs around 30 °C. Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD) calls it wet. At this lead kenya_met has the best record, right 75% of the time over 16 checks.

Further out, temperatures and winds much the same through Saturday, with showers and thunderstorms likely Wednesday and Thursday, and showers and thunderstorms possible Friday and Saturday. Wednesday: all four models wet, highs 30 to 32 °C. Thursday: all four models wet, the week's wettest day at 10 mm on average, highs 30 to 33 °C. Friday: all three models that reach it wet, highs around 29 °C, thunder possible rather than likely.

Only GFS, ECMWF and ICON reach past Thursday. GFS and ICON are the wetter solutions from Wednesday to Thursday; ECMWF and UKMO keep it drier. Saturday's call: rain, 100%, with both models wet; highs around 29 °C. At this lead ECMWF has the best record, right 77% of the time over 59 checks.

## Severe Weather / Hazard Potential

Thunderstorms today are driven by peak CAPE values reaching 4050 J/kg in UKMO, 1730 J/kg in ECMWF, 1710 J/kg in Best Match, 1270 J/kg in GFS, and 850 J/kg in ICON, with four models exceeding the thunderstorm threshold and peaking at 17:00. Any thunderstorm brings the hazard of sudden gusts well above the forecast wind. No official weather warning is active from the met service.

## Winam Gulf — Conditions for Boaters

On Winam Gulf, wind is east-northeasterly overnight at 6 km/h (3 kt) gusting 8 km/h (4 kt), then by midday at 9 km/h (5 kt) gusting 20 km/h (11 kt), then into the evening at 8 km/h (4 kt) gusting 18 km/h (10 kt); peak gust 28 km/h (15 kt). Any thunderstorm brings the hazard of sudden gusts well above the forecast wind.

## Detailed Discussion

### Synoptic Overview

Across roughly 2,600 km, pressure is lowest toward the north (1010 hPa) and highest toward the southeast (1016 hPa) — a 6 hPa spread, a moderate large-scale gradient. Pressure is also falling toward the south — a large-scale feature building in that direction, though this sampling cannot say how fast or whether it will reach here. Pressure overhead is near-steady, while the local pressure trend is +0.8 hPa. Sampling is a nine-point ring at 12-degree spacing, so this locates a direction, not a centre or a front. Across 5 points, today's mean sea-level pressure sits between 1013.8 and 1015.8 hPa; near-steady over three days (-1.0 hPa).

### Forecaster Confidence Notes

At Day+0, no model is meaningfully better than the others overall. The call sets a high of 29°C / 84°F and low of 20°C / 67°F; GFS predicts a higher 29.8°C in line with its bias to over-forecast daytime highs, while ECMWF predicts 27.5°C and ICON 26.3°C, reflecting known low daytime high biases. ICON sits at 22.2°C for low temperature, reflecting its tendency to over-forecast overnight lows. All models agree on rainfall today, though amounts range from 3.9 mm in Best Match to 23.7 mm in UKMO. Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD) predicts a maximum of 30.0°C and minimum of 20.0°C with afternoon showers and thunderstorms, broadly agreeing with the call. Data sufficiency shows a settled picture at Day+0 with at least 49 checks per model, though Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD) has fewer checks. Day+3 has 16 checks per model, while Day+7 has 59 checks. Best Match duplicates ECMWF rain probability, so those metrics count once.
